_comment: Alternate-port emulator config for parallel worktree dev — lets a second emulator suite run next to the main checkout's default-port suite. Same rules/functions as firebase.json, every port +10000. Point the apps at it via NEXT_PUBLIC_*_EMULATOR_PORT (web) / *_EMULATOR_HOST (admin, scripts). Start: pnpm exec firebase emulators:start --config firebase.worktree.json --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-linyup
